source_row.rationale: The traditional "three checks" of medication administration involve comparing the medication label to the medication administration record (MAR) at three points: when first removing the medication from storage, when preparing or pouring the dose, and immediately before administering it to the client at the bedside — a safety practice to catch potential errors at multiple points in the process.
source_row.source_detail: Timing and Purpose of the Three Label Checks
source_row.source_name: Standard Nursing Fundamentals — Three Checks of Medication Administration
